messages:
maria: thinking about adding a per-model cost overlay to the Console 	6 shows token-level cost, cache savings, and amortized quantization uplift per model/version. should this be computed in the Console backend, or do we expose a lightweight `cost_hint` in the inference API so apps can surface realtime estimates? :thinking:
kevin: +1 for exposing a `cost_hint` field in the API so other apps (and SDKs) can show it. main worry: doing more work in the hot path could add latency. it should be opt-in and cached.
alex: console-side precomputation is cheaper for dashboards (batch jobs, materialized views). downside: stale for rollouts/canaries where we need near-realtime expected cost changes.
sara: we already have the pieces to make a cheap estimate at request time: token predictor, cached per-model token-rate, and a simple cache-hit probability model. estimate is just arithmetic and a small lookup 	6 should be ~1-2ms on CPU if we keep params in-memory. sample proto idea:
```json
"cost_hint": {
  "estimated_tokens": 128,
  "estimated_compute_ms": 42,
  "estimated_token_units": 0.0143,
  "cache_savings_units": 0.0041,
  "confidence": "0.86",
  "note": "estimate; invoiceable units may differ"
}
```
tina: UX: please surface as an "Estimate" and give a toggle: [include cache savings] vs [raw model units]. For rollouts, show a range (lower/upper) because cache behavior can vary across tenants.
maria: billing parity concern 	6 customers will compare dashboard estimates to invoices. we must be explicit: show as estimate and link to billing docs. agree on adding `confidence` and a human-readable tooltip.
kevin: implementation details: add `?include_cost_hints=true` query param or an opt-in header to avoid surprising latency for everyone. SDKs can opt in per-route. and we should version the field (cost_hint_v1).
alex: also ensure we never include tenant identifiers or sample data in the hint. only model-level aggregates + per-request token estimate. don't leak other customers' usage.
sara: i'll prototype an inline estimator in the sandbox branch (eng-ml/sandbox/cost-hint) and run p95 latency tests. if median < 2ms we'll propose API opt-in header `x-rw-include-cost-hint` and a small toggle in Console.
maria: follow-ups: sara 	6 prototype + perf numbers, kevin 	6 API contract PR sketch, tina 	6 UX copy + tooltip. plan to canary at 10% traffic and compare estimate->actual billing delta. any objections?
kevin: no objections. test matrix: 10% canary, track estimate error distribution, cold-starts, and model-variant differences. I'll add it to the release war room board.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for sandbox/cost-hint branch (run tests)
kevin: noted, will watch results and add perf reqs to the PR.
